feat: exfer_quote_issue / exfer_quote_verify MCP tools (issue #28)
In exfer-stack/exfer-mcp, his own repository.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-mcp/pull/1

Wave 2 (exfer-mcp half) of the EXFER-QUOTE standard (ahuman-exfer/exfer#28). Exposes walletd's quote RPCs (exfer-stack/exfer-walletd#2) to agents via the exfer-py client methods (exfer-stack/exfer-py#1).

## What
- New `tools/quote.py`:
  - **`exfer_quote_issue`** — Spend-posture (signs a binding price credential with a managed key; description flags it as such). Returns the signed `quote` + payee-side `htlc_preimage`/`htlc_hash_lock`.
  - **`exfer_quote_verify`** — pure Read; reconstructs the signing image and checks signature / key validity / TTL windows. No state change.
  - Handlers are thin wrappers: call `client.quote_issue` / `client.quote_verify`, `json_text` the result.
- Registered in `TOOLS` + `HANDLERS`; tool count **18 → 20**.
- **No MCP-side scope check** by design — a Read-scoped token hitting `exfer_quote_issue` fails at walletd (`-32001`) and is surfaced by `render_error`, asserted by `test_quote_issue_scope_denied_renders_error`.

## Dependency pin
`pyproject.toml` adds a **temporary** `[tool.uv.sources]` override pinning `exfer-walletd` to the exfer-py `feat/quote-rpc` commit (`5225302`), so a clean `uv sync` provisions an SDK that actually carries `quote_issue`/`quote_verify` (the published PyPI 0.8.0 predates them). Repoint to the merge commit — or drop the block for a real PyPI release — once exfer-stack/exfer-py#1 lands.

## Tests
`uv run pytest` green — **16 passed**, including the three quote handler tests and the `len(TOOLS) == 20` guard. `ruff` + `mypy` clean.

## Note
Scoped to the quote tools only. An in-flight governance/voting feature in the same working tree was deliberately kept out of this PR.
